items.question: What does reading a stored value that matches no status or known old spelling return?
items.ticket: Existing values are normalised when read
items.chose: Returns null, never the nearest status.
items.instead: Throw an error, or fall back to a default status such as draft.

items.question: Does reading ignore letter case and surrounding whitespace in stored values?
items.chose: Trims both ends and lowercases the value before matching, so "  PUBLISHED " reads as published.
items.instead: Match only exact lowercase values, or lowercase without trimming.

items.question: How are separators such as hyphens, underscores and repeated spaces treated when reading?
items.chose: Collapses any run of whitespace, "-" and "_" into one space, so "in_review" and "in   review" both become "in review".
items.instead: Treat each separator as distinct, or strip separators entirely.

items.question: Which old spellings map to which enum values?
items.ticket: Sandbox status is stored as free text (draft, Draft, in-review...)
items.chose: Maps only "in review" (after cleaning) to review. No other aliases exist, and "inreview" reads as null.
items.instead: Add more aliases (for example "in progress", "done", "inreview") or fuzzy matching.

items.question: What does writing a value do when it is not exactly an enum value, such as "Draft" or the old spelling "in-review"?
items.chose: Throws an Error and does not normalise it. Only exact lowercase enum values pass through.
items.instead: Normalise the value with the read logic and write the result, throwing only for unknown values.

items.question: What error does an invalid write raise, and what does its message contain?
items.chose: Throws a plain Error whose message includes the quoted value and the list of valid statuses.
items.instead: Throw a custom error class, or return null or a result object without throwing.

items.question: What happens when the value to write or read is an empty or whitespace-only string?
items.chose: Writing "" throws. Reading "" or "   " returns null.
items.instead: Treat empty as a default status such as draft, or reject empty input separately.

items.question: When reading many rows, is a row with an unreadable status kept or dropped?
items.chose: Keeps the row in order with its status set to null.
items.instead: Drop unreadable rows from the output, or throw on the first one.

items.question: How are unreadable values reported for a batch read: in what form, with what de-duplication, and in what order?
items.chose: Lists each distinct raw stored string once, uncleaned, so "alpha" and "Alpha " are separate entries, sorted with the default string sort.
items.instead: Report cleaned values, report row ids, keep first-seen order, or list duplicates.

items.question: Does batch reading keep the input row order and ids?
items.chose: Maps rows one-to-one, preserving order and ids.
items.instead: Group or sort rows, or de-duplicate by id.
